name: Mirror Learning Forge
boundaries: Installed does not mean opted in.
Public health is read-only; every state-bearing or write API route requires the runtime local bearer token.
A captured session is not a lesson.
A permitted lesson is not a promoted model.
Training never mutates the active checkpoint.
A Seam Cell verdict cannot be closed by fluent language.
Mirror Core integration exports a DRAFT change packet only; live application is disabled.
Experience may grow exponentially; authority, promotion, stage unlocks, and tools remain separately gated.
Valid JSON never proves a claim true by syntax alone.
Coding submissions are parsed and statically graded; arbitrary code is not executed in v0.7.
Mirror may choose a Studio class, but class choice remains an unapproved training task until steward review.
Studio draw packets are statically graded against the real PR14 tool contract; no pixels are changed inside the Forge.
Creative success requires a later pre/post screenshot receipt from the actual Studio eyes loop.
Technical skill never grants tool, network, filesystem, apply, or promotion authority.
Each training track receives separate held-out evidence so one strong format cannot hide another regression.
Root anchors are taught through scenarios, consequences, tensions and repair; phrase repetition is not treated as understanding.
Mirror may file dissent about root interpretation, but cannot silently edit root canon or grant itself authority.
Mirror may choose a Reasoning School class, but the task remains awaiting review and challenger-only.
Reasoning receipts expose inspectable checkpoints without requiring private hidden chain-of-thought.
The reasoning development profile contains no single IQ score, human-equivalence claim, or ranking.
Reasoning improvement never grants tool, execution, network, filesystem, promotion, canon, or apply authority.
The v0.7 school does not claim that the tiny token learner already has native broad reasoning or adaptive-communication organs.
Adaptivity is a learned cross-root capability, not a fifth AXM root.
Protected meaning fields and delivery fields are recorded separately before adaptation is graded.
Audience models are tentative working hypotheses, never identity truth or permission to profile secretly.
Communicative success means grounded understanding, not agreement, approval, obedience, or emotional dependence.
Adaptation may change tone, depth, order, examples, medium, pace and format; it may not silently change facts, evidence status, uncertainty, consent, lineage, risk, identity or permission state.
MAINTAIN is a valid adaptive decision when the existing form already works; constant convergence is not required.
The school grades bounded receipts only; native adaptivity organs remain a separate Codex integration seam.
